sources.entry: anotifier by Amin Dhouib (Devino Solutions) - A zero-dependency, cross-platform notifier that fires a desktop toast and a free phone push (via ntfy) the moment Claude Code (or Codex/Cursor/Gemini) finishes a task or needs input, wired up by a one-command setup. The standout among notifiers is its testing rigor — CI drives the *real* agent CLIs end to end and asserts real ntfy round-trips and real

summary.one_liner: A zero-dependency Node.js tool that sends desktop toast, phone push (via ntfy), webhook and terminal-bell alerts when AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI or Antigravity CLI finish a task or need input.
summary.what_it_does: Hooks into each supported agent's native hook system, configured by a setup wizard (npx anotifier@latest setup) that detects installed tools and patches their configs. On finish or permission/input requests it fires a desktop toast (BurntToast on Windows, Notification Center on macOS, libnotify on Linux, with WSL routed to Windows), a free ntfy phone push, a webhook (Slack, Discord, Telegram or generic HTTP), and a terminal bell. For Claude Code it can include the assistant's last message or question in the notification and reports turn length. It also offers quiet hours, snooze, per-project overrides, custom sound files, usage-limit and context-size warnings for Claude Code, and an opt-in anonymous usage stats setting. Config lives in ~/.anotifier/config.json, shared across tools.
use_cases: get notified when Claude Code finishes a long task
get a phone push when an AI coding agent needs permission
send AI agent alerts to Slack or Discord
warn before Claude Code hits a usage limit or auto-compacts
silence agent notifications during nightly quiet hours
hear a terminal bell when an agent over SSH or tmux finishes
stack: Node.js (built-in modules only, no npm production dependencies)
notable: Zero dependencies: pure Node.js built-ins, with a one-command setup wizard that wires hooks for each agent
Rich notification content for Claude Code: shows Claude's actual question or last message, read from the transcript
Claude Code usage-limit (5-hour and weekly) and auto-compact context warnings via a statusline wrapper
Per-project overrides in the user's own config, plus quiet hours, snooze and minimum turn duration filter
Codex approval alerts fire when Codex asks permission, not only at turn end
caveats: Antigravity CLI support is not exercised by a live CI lane and has not been tested against a real run; it has no needs-input alert and every Stop says Task complete
Desktop toast behaviour differs per OS: click-to-focus is Windows only, and Linux sound is only played for custom sound files; Cursor turns are untimed
Rich content and usage/context warnings are Claude Code only; ntfy rich content is off by default for privacy on the public ntfy.sh server
keywords: know when ai finishes a task
notify me when claude needs input
